summary: Vocash backend fully tested via public preview URL. 30/30 pytest tests passed covering health, settings CRUD + test-key (401/400), suppliers CRUD with balance/billsTotal/paymentsTotal, bills CRUD with USD+CDF conversion, sales CRUD, payments (supplier_payment reduces balance, drawing stores partnerName), inventory expected/create with variance, dashboard KPIs & salesTrend, reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance), AI endpoints returning 401 without key. No MongoDB _id leakage. All routes are /api-prefixed. Test data cleaned up after run.

minor.issue: Returns googleApiKey in plaintext even though a comment in code says 'Mask key'. Consider masking (e.g., last 4 chars) before returning to client.
Returns 200 with {ok:true} even when supplier doesn't exist (idempotent). Not a bug, but no 404 signaling for nonexistent IDs.

Does not cascade-delete associated bills/payments. Orphaned bills remain referencing the deleted supplierId (they still show up in /api/bills and continue contributing to dashboard aggregates). Consider cascade delete or a warning.

action_items: (Optional) Mask googleApiKey in GET /api/settings response (currently returned in plaintext).
(Optional) On DELETE /api/suppliers/{id}, also delete related bills & payments, or block deletion if outstanding balance != 0.
(Optional) Return 404 on delete of nonexistent supplier/bill/sale/payment/inventory for clearer client feedback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_settings docstring says 'Mask key' but returns key in plaintext.
Endpoints do not enforce role/tenant isolation because this is single-user by design (OK per PRD).

get_api_key correctly raises 401 with expected detail 'Missing Google Gemini API key. Set it in Settings.'; ai endpoints wrap general Exception in 400 but re-raise HTTPException 401 correctly (verified by tests).
Bill.rate defaults to 1.0 — when currency is CDF and no rate is provided, dashboard falls back to settings.fcRate correctly. Verified via CDF bill test.
Frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo standard) — used correctly. No hardcoded URLs in server.py.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed supplier, 2 bills (USD + CDF), 1 sale, 1 supplier_payment, 1 drawing, 1 inventory audit. All deleted at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is stable. Use /app/backend/tests/test_vocash_backend.py as regression base. Public URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. All tests run against the public preview URL. If retesting AI endpoints with a real Gemini key, set googleApiKey via PUT /api/settings or pass via 'x-gemini-api-key' header.
